name: @w6w-apps/deepseek
description: Chat completions, FIM code completion, model listing and account balance via the DeepSeek API.

w6w.longDescription:
DeepSeek runs chat completions from a workflow against an OpenAI-Chat-Completions-shaped endpoint, with two DeepSeek-specific controls layered on top: a `thinking` switch (its reasoning models default to thinking mode ON, unlike OpenAI's opt-in `reasoning_effort`) and a `reasoningEffort` knob (low/high/max) that shapes how much chain-of-thought the model spends before answering. The reply carries the final `content` and, in thinking mode, a separate `reasoning_content` field — the model's visible chain-of-thought — so a workflow can log or discard it independently of the answer.

A Beta FIM (Fill-In-the-Middle) completion action covers code-completion-shaped prompts (a prefix and, optionally, a suffix) against a base model — the same request shape editor/IDE integrations use, exposed here as a workflow step rather than requiring a full chat-formatted prompt. Models can be listed to keep a workflow's model choice current: DeepSeek has renamed its model line before, and the API's own `/models` endpoint is the only source that will not go stale. Account balance can be read directly, so a workflow can check headroom before a batch of calls rather than discovering a 402 mid-run.

A fit for adding an LLM step to a workflow — especially one that wants visibility into the model's reasoning process, or a lower-cost alternative to a frontier chat model for summarizing, classifying or drafting code.
